rule: Demands guide research design. Registration only — no ingest, no Civic Record product, no new panel, no rights-conditioning experiment.
hard_boundary: Participation may be studied as civic expectation; political rights must never depend on participation.

demands.name: civic_association_density_comparative
demands.question: How do Tocqueville-style association density and social-capital measures vary across comparable communities, and what outcomes co-vary?

demands.name: civic_connectivity_indicator
demands.question: Can we measure share of population connected to functioning civic relationships (not party registration)?

demands.name: participatory_budgeting_agency_outcomes
demands.question: Where participatory budgeting or neighborhood capital priority systems exist, does participation produce durable agency or ceremonial consultation?

demands.name: neighborhood_council_and_precinct_systems
demands.question: What do neighborhood councils, precinct organizations, and similar granular networks deliver — and for whom?

demands.name: volunteer_fire_mutual_aid_cooperatives
demands.question: What can volunteer fire systems, mutual aid, unions, and cooperatives teach about ordinary participation becoming prestige and capacity?

demands.name: citizen_assemblies_and_digital_networks
demands.question: When do citizen assemblies and digital civic networks deepen agency versus recentralize power or amplify faction?

demands.name: failure_mode_capture_exclusion
demands.question: In which intensive-participation cases did capture or exclusion of minorities/newcomers occur?

demands.name: failure_mode_burnout_factionalism
demands.question: Where did intensive participation produce burnout or local factionalism that reduced resilience?

demands.name: conformity_pressure_vs_productive_disagreement
demands.question: When does a civic-duty culture tip into conformity pressure that punishes honest disagreement?

demands.name: civic_record_boundary_safety
demands.question: Can a voluntary Civic Record of service exist without becoming a government score or rights qualification?

demands.name: journalism_network_joint_system
demands.question: How do local news/civic-information systems and relational civic networks co-vary — information without relationships, and relationships without information?

demands.name: continuous_civic_education_loops
demands.question: Do continuous civic-education → participation → experience loops raise durable capacity versus one-off voter guides?

demands.name: leadership_pipeline_from_ordinary_participation
demands.question: Do communities with explicit participant→volunteer→steward→board→office pipelines produce more plural leadership than money/party machinery alone?

demands.name: arkansas_living_lab_granularity
demands.question: In designated Arkansas research geographies, what is the actual grain of functioning networks (neighborhoods, precincts, school communities, churches, co-ops)?
